pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)Crafted at the Crafting Station; the three tiers need town level 1, 10 and 20 respectively.$()$(br2)A magic compass always points at your town hall, so you never lose your way home. The advanced tier also shows the town hall's coordi
nates in its tooltip, and the ultimate tier goes one step further: right-click and it teleports you straight there.
